name: Inbox
description: One panel with everything that needs you, from every plugin that offers an inbox feed (Google Chat, Gmail and Jira today), ranked by your own rules, with done, snooze and undo, a Read list to reopen what you already read, and today's calendar as a strip with the next meeting and Join (with the Calendar plugin). No account and no network calls of its own: it reads the other plugins through their services. Needs cc-cockpit 0.9.7 or later, and Chat 0.2.0, Gmail 0.4.0, Jira 0.6.0 or Calendar 0.2.0 as sources.
author: BronOS
